segments.comment: A xorn (wizard-mode #polyself) walks the north wall of the arrival room: HWALL, TLCORNER, VWALL, back along HWALL, through the doorway, to TRCORNER and the rock above, waiting with m-prefixed searches so each 'changed' terrain highlight expires before the next move. botl.c compare_blstats() compares BL_TERRAIN with strcmp(): blstats[][BL_TERRAIN] is initblstats[]'s armor entry (init_blstats() copies by position), so its terrain_typ cheat never fires. Only Stairs->Wall, Wall->Doorway->Wall and Wall->Stone highlight; the moves between wall types do not.
